fields.name: value
fields.documentation: A value meaningful only LOCALLY -- a source identifier, a cluster number, a condition name. A TERM has a namespace and an id; a label has neither, only a name. Boundary test: shared or compared across datasets -> a term (mint one if none exists); confined to one source or run -> a label (item 33). One entry, or a list of them along the value's `dimensions`, whose `covariates` say what each entry is (#73 review D1; `keys` until 2026-10-22).

fields.name: name
fields.documentation: The label. A string even when it looks numeric (leading zeros; identifiers wider than 2^53).
